Cable Spacing

50mm vs 75mm Cable Spacing

Understanding which spacing configuration is right for your home opening.

50 mm (2 Inches)
Child & Pet Safety Standard

Strictly prevents toddler heads, hands, or household pets from squeezing through. Recommended for all balconies on the 3rd floor and higher where kids play.

75 mm (3 Inches)
Panoramic Open View Standard

Provides maximum visual openness while safely blocking adult body falls. Popular for master bedroom French windows and adult living sky-decks.

Metallurgical Rigour

Engineered For Extreme Durability

Every millimeter of our invisible grill system is engineered from marine and aerospace alloys to deliver unyielding fall resistance without degrading over time.

ANATOMY OF SS316 CABLE

Cross-Section Multi-Strand Cable

1

DuPont Pure Nylon Encapsulation

High-grade transparent membrane prevents hand friction, repels moisture and airborne salt, and filters UV light to prevent steel thermal expansion.

2

7×7 High-Tensile Wire Core

49 micro-strands of virgin 316 marine-grade steel tightly wound to achieve 400+ kgf tensile capacity while preserving smooth flexibility.

3

6063-T6 Aerospace Track System

Extruded architectural aluminium profiles treated with 25-micron hard anodization to anchor securely into solid concrete without twisting.

STEEL GRADE
AISI 316 Marine

Contains 2.5% Molybdenum specifically formulated to resist chloride attack and pitting.

TENSILE TOLERANCE
400+ kg Breaking Load

Certified to withstand massive kinetic impact forces without cable deformation.

ANCHORING SYSTEM
M8/M10 Concrete Anchors

Heavy-duty expansion studs seated deep into slab concrete for permanent stability.

OPTICAL CLARITY
98% Open Vista

Allows complete daylight immersion and unhindered skyline vistas from all room angles.

Direct Comparison

Invisible Grills vs Traditional Grills

Compare how modern architectural SS316 invisible grills radically outperform outdated heavy iron bars across safety, aesthetics, and building compliance.

Feature / Factor InvisProtect SS316 Invisible Grills Traditional MS / Iron Box Grills
Visual Transparency ✓ 98% Unobstructed panoramic vista ✗ Blocks 40–60% of natural view & daylight
Child Fall Prevention ✓ Cannot be climbed (zero horizontal steps) ✗ Creates ladder footholds children can climb
Rust & Weather Resistance ✓ SS316 Marine Grade (100% rust-proof) ✗ Prone to rust; requires painting every 2 years
Fire Rescue & Evacuation ✓ Can be cut by firemen in seconds with wire cutters ✗ Lethal fire trap: cannot be cut without power saws
Society / RWA Elevation Rules ✓ 100% compliant; maintains building façade ✗ Frequently banned by luxury high-rise RWAs
Maintenance Effort ✓ Zero maintenance; simple water wipe down ✗ High; rust scraping, sanding & messy paint
